claim_text: ISO 22734-1:2025 specifies safety requirements for hydrogen gas generation appliances or systems using electrochemical water electrolysis.
GB/T 29729-2022 氢系统安全的基本要求 is listed as current, published 2022-12-30 and effective 2023-04-01.

The official registry confirms GB/T 45541-2025 is a current national method standard for PEM electrolyzer performance testing. The public detail page exposes status, dates, standard category and identity; its full technical clauses are not treated as publicly verified here.

GB/T 46104-2025 covers test plan, data acquisition plan, pre-test checks, instruments, measurement methods, steady/dynamic/start-stop tests, and report content including purpose, instruments/equipment, operator qualification, calculations, charts, and conclusion.
GB/T 27748.2-2022 is the current Chinese national standard for performance test methods of stationary fuel-cell power systems.
IEC 62282-2-100:2020 covers construction, normal/abnormal operation, and testing safety requirements for fuel-cell modules.
IEC 62282-3-100:2019 applies to stationary packaged fuel-cell power systems for indoor/outdoor commercial, industrial, and residential use in non-hazardous areas.
ISO/IEC 17025 addresses competence, impartiality, and consistent operation of testing and calibration laboratories.
ISO/IEC 42001 specifies requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an AI management system.
ISO/IEC 23894:2023 provides guidance for effective implementation and integration of AI risk management processes.
The user announcement names T02 as equipment test-data analysis and automatic reporting and says enterprises provide desensitized data, technical Q&A, and materials.

The official national-standard project page lists test scope, conditions, preparation, data-acquisition plans, pre-test checks, instrument accuracy, electrical input measurements including voltage, current, and electrical power, hydrogen output flow/purity/temperature/pressure, environmental temperature/humidity/pressure, cold/hot start, steady, dynamic, shutdown tests, and report fields including purpose, instruments, operator qualification, calculations, charts, and conclusion.

The public technical-content summary supports separating test stages, test conditions, measurement methods, and efficiency/result evidence into profile-controlled gates; it does not provide enterprise-specific numeric limits or efficiency equations.

The official project technical-content page lists the test system composition, including rectifier power supply, electrolyzer, gas-liquid separation, optional purification, circulation, thermal management, and control system; TestLens records these as profile-controlled evidence items without asserting that a generic configuration is compliant.

The official project technical-content page identifies test site/environment conditions and environmental measurement as part of the method workflow; TestLens separates environment-condition records from general test-condition and abnormal-disposition records.

The public technical-content summary identifies cold start, hot start, steady, dynamic, and shutdown tests and related calculations. TestLens computes generic phase KPIs and requires a separate phase result evidence reference before an approved profile can form a human-review package; it does not invent standard duration, ramp, or acceptance limits.

The public workflow summary supports presenting ordered test stages and report provenance fields. TestLens maps this to workflowSequence and separate operator/operatorQualification metadata; these are evidence gates, not proof of accreditation or conformity.
